items.problem: the server start check of `## data` of the attendance spec ("When there is a row whose `reward` is an empty array and `extra_grant` is `false` ... the server does not start", skills/server-core/modules/attendance.md:159) is not implemented: `complete_start` only checks `extra_grant` rows against a missing `grant_attendance_extra`, nothing else in `server/core` or the core test data invariants (`test-data/data/invariants.csv:7-9` has only `order_column` and `child_exists`) rejects such a row, and `grant_reward` (server/core/attendance/index.ts:220) returns `pass` for an empty `reward`, so a day row `[cal],1,,false` starts the server and `ClaimAttendance` succeeds, writes progress and grants nothing. No test of `server/core/attendance/tests/` covers the `## test` item "When there is a row that violates the data rules, the server does not start". The attendance code is unchanged in the commit range, so this existed before it
